transport: MCP Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON responses over unencrypted 127.0.0.1 loopback, no compression
timing: Client roundTripMs starts immediately before http.request and ends after complete response receipt and JSON parsing; request serialization and validation assertions are outside it. Server handling includes body receipt, parsing, selection and response serialization; excludes socket send and sample recording.
measurementLimits: Synthetic uncompressed ASCII data; no product reasoning or storage updates.
100 measured requests after 10 warmups per case, sequential concurrency 1, fixed case order, one run on this machine.
Codex tool durations are observed CLI start/completion-event intervals; event buffering can affect precision. They exclude model request generation and model consumption after delivery.
No relaxation of agent output limits: Codex received 128-byte payloads only. Larger payloads were measured by the deterministic client.
CLI total elapsed includes startup, model work, waits and shutdown; these were not independently attributed. Zero reported reasoning-output tokens is not evidence of zero reasoning.
No comparison with STDIO round-trip latency has been made.
Parent setup, code generation and reporting are outside the recorded test windows.
